label: F38#6
brief: 3 in-game frames (Meadows) for one catalogue subject: ground pickup identity. Judge that subject as the game's real look - identity and read at a glance, silhouette, palette, lighting and fit with the key art and its chapter board.
defects: Many unrelated ground pickups share small glowing plants, orbs or generic crates, so their item identity is difficult to read at normal camera distance
